description_excerpt: Job Description Junior Managers Program (JMP) is Bosch’s fast-track development program designed to prepare high-potential early-career professionals for future leadership and key business roles. During a period of 12 to 24 months, you complete four to six assignments in your functional area, including one placement abroad. You are actively involved in day-to-day business and projects as well as benefiting from professional and individual guidance.
